intro: The Warrior's Path is an introductory martial quest offered to budding fighters on Zephras Isle. Following instructions delivered through Rorian the Dayseeker, young warriors are directed to Blademaster Ren in the Thendal Village watchtower. Ren stands ready to offer combat instruction and discipline to those prepared to shield their people.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: While you were gone our warrior trainer--Blademaster Ren--requested that we send you their way when you returned. She dropped this note off for you as well.
Give it a read, then find Blademaster Ren inside the village watchtower.

clips.title: Progress
paras: So you've come for training, then?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You are about to embark upon a dangerous journey. Our world is changing and it will need those who have the will to lead and protect others if our people hope to survive. As you grow in power you will need guidance. Come to me--I will do what I can to train you as you progress.
Good luck, friend, may the winds guide you.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
